Name: Rufus, Son of Simon of Cyrene
Summary: Rufus was a son of Simon of Cyrene, named by Mark alongside his brother Alexander. Paul later greets a Rufus, chosen in the Lord, in Rome, who may be the same man, though the text does not say so.
KeyStory: Mark names Rufus only as the son of the man who carried Jesus' cross.
RelatedPeople: Simon of Cyrene; Alexander, Son of Simon of Cyrene
LifeLesson: A name in one verse can outlive an empire. Rufus is remembered because his father carried a cross.
